name: tma_align_input_scale
description: This definition covers the contiguous, row-major inputs exercised by the current test and benchmark suites; the declared return alias applies to that workload. DeepGEMM TMA scale-layout adapter for a two-dimensional fp32 activation-scale tensor [M, K]. Semantically this is a layout operation only: values are unchanged. Whenever the input is contiguous, including every suite case (a freshly built row-major torch.rand [M, K]), the native entry point returns the input tensor object itself, so the result aliases input_scale; the pure-torch reference `return input_scale` aliases in the same way. Only for a non-contiguous/strided input does the native path allocate a fresh buffer and write the width-transposed, padded layout into it (M padded to a multiple of 16/element_size, pad columns zeroed), returning a transposed view of that new buffer, which does not alias the input. Inputs are never mutated. The separate non-contiguous allocation path is outside this definition workload.
